hard_gate_failures: Gate 6: slide 1 has a circled arrow below the watch. Owner rules and lessons count this as a stray shape.
Gate 6: slide 1 headline and tag sit on the top of the watch case and strap instead of in a clear band above the watch.
Lesson: slides 4 and 5 are two slides on one watch, with no distinct claim each. Slides 3 to 5 are plain text on black.
fixes: slide 1: remove the circled arrow. Move the watch photo lower, or shrink it, so the tag and headline sit in a clear band above the case.

slides 4-5: merge into one slide, for example 'Santos-Dumont WSSA0085, steel: USD 5,250 on cartier.com, 25 Nov 2026'. Show the Cartier press photo of that watch on it, cropped differently or with a text-free layout. Remove 'this one' wording that has nothing to point at.
slide 3: add a permitted Cartier or public-domain image of the 1904 Santos or Santos-Dumont. Do not use black text slides for the whole middle of the story.
post: there is no 'how it works' or 'why collectors care' step. Add one distinct, sourced claim, or retitle the post as a history story. Keep the caption CTA the same as the CTA slide.
reason: The facts and the price check out and the validator passes. But the cover has a stray arrow and a crowded headline, and the middle slides are text-only, with the price split across two slides.
